entities.name: MnmA (B1ILH4)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Clostridium botulinum tRNA-specific 2-thiouridylase MnmA (UniProt B1ILH4).
Catalyzes 2-thiolation of tRNA wobble-position uridine U34 to form 2-thiouridine (s2U34); EC 2.8.1.13.
Annotated as cytoplasmic; GO:0002143 tRNA wobble position uridine thiolation and GO:0103016 tRNA-uridine 2-sulfurtransferase activity.

entities.name: tRNA U34 thiolation
observations: MnmA-dependent modification introduces sulfur at uridine 34 of tRNA, generating s2U34.

entities.name: Cytoplasm
observations: Reviewed MnmA reference annotation places the protein in the cytoplasm.
